problems.title: Payment Required
problems.description: The requested resource requires payment. The server has included a WWW-Authenticate challenge describing acceptable payment methods.

problems.title: Payment Insufficient
problems.description: The payment amount provided is too low to satisfy the server's price for this resource.

problems.title: Payment Expired
problems.description: The challenge or authorization has expired. The client should request a fresh challenge and retry.

problems.title: Verification Failed
problems.description: The payment proof included in the credential could not be verified by the server.

problems.title: Method Unsupported
problems.description: The payment method specified by the client is not accepted by this server.

problems.title: Malformed Credential
problems.description: The credential format is invalid and could not be parsed by the server.

problems.title: Invalid Challenge
problems.description: The challenge ID is unknown, expired, or has already been used.

problems.title: Invalid Signature
problems.description: The voucher or close-request signature could not be verified.

problems.title: Signer Mismatch
problems.description: The signer is not authorized for this payment channel.

problems.title: Amount Exceeds Deposit
problems.description: The voucher amount exceeds the channel deposit.

problems.title: Delta Too Small
problems.description: The amount increase is below the server's minimum voucher delta.

problems.title: Channel Not Found
problems.description: No payment channel with this ID exists.

problems.title: Channel Finalized
problems.description: The payment channel has been closed and can no longer accept vouchers.

problems.title: Challenge Not Found
problems.description: The challenge ID is unknown or has expired.

problems.title: Insufficient Balance
problems.description: There is insufficient authorized balance in the channel for this request.

problems.title: Bad Request
problems.description: The request is malformed or contains invalid parameters. Correct the request before retrying.

problems.title: Invalid Payload
problems.description: The credential payload does not match the expected schema.

problems.title: Internal Payment Error
problems.description: Payment processing failed because of an unexpected internal error.

problems.title: Payment Action Required
problems.description: The payment requires additional action, such as 3DS authentication.
